newsitem.title: CHINA: President Jiang Zemin to visit Russia to sign troop agreement.
newsitem.headline: President Jiang Zemin to visit Russia to sign troop agreement.

text.p: China's President Jiang Zemin is to visit Russia in April to sign an agreement to reduce troops along its border with Russia and three Central Asian states, Premier Li Peng said on Friday.
"China and Russia, the two sides will, together with the three Central Asian nations, sign a border trrop reduction agrement," Li said.
"It will be conducive to peace and friendly neighbourly relations along the borders," Li told a news conference.
The visit would take place in April, he said.
Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan would be the other signatories to the agreement.
